battle.name: 征服難陀帝國
battle.brief: 公元前321年前後，旃陀羅笈多在考底利耶策劃下起兵，聯合摩蹉國王帕爾瓦塔與山林部眾，先以夜襲擊潰難陀大軍，再圍攻攻陷摩揭陀首都華氏城，難陀王朝覆亡，孔雀帝國取而代之。卡面這件青銅長矛與印度步兵的銅柄長矛屬於同一技術家族，在兩軍裝備序列中位置相同：弓箭手之後的近戰矛兵線上。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 征服難陀帝國是公元前321年前後，孔雀聯盟推翻難陀王朝、奪取摩揭陀的一場戰爭，交戰的主體是兩個以摩揭陀為核心的政權。難陀一方是難陀王朝的末代君主達那難陀（Dhana Nanda）與其所屬的摩揭陀王國：都城在恆河與松河交會處的華氏城（Pataliputra），國土北抵喜馬拉雅山麓與呾叉始羅（Taxila），南盡恆河三角洲與奧里薩海岸，東及孟加拉，控制的正是南亞最肥沃的那一段河谷平原。難陀朝以重稅、常備軍與龐大的象軍立國，宮廷設有度支官與司庫；據普魯塔克轉述，難陀王的財富達薛西斯所留的萬倍以上，查士丁《史記摘要》則記其軍隊有步兵二十萬、騎兵二萬、戰車二千、戰象二千。這些數字出自後世轉述，學界多視為系統性夸大的概數，但足以說明當時人對難陀國力的想象有多麼龐大。孔雀一方起初並不是一個國家，而是以旃陀羅笈多為核心、由考底利耶策劃的起兵集團，核心兵力是摩蹉國王帕爾瓦塔所部的步騎與象，加上山林部落的弓手與難陀境內暗中倒向起兵者的徵召網。這場戰爭也不是兩軍對撞：北方的拘羅等邦國站在難陀一邊，孔雀聯盟則以換掉整套稅制、軍制與朝廷為共同目標，目標從推翻一家一姓擴展為接管整個摩揭陀國的財政與武力機器。
countriesEn: The conquest of the Nanda Empire was the war fought around 321 BCE in which a Maurya coalition overthrew the Nanda dynasty and seized Magadha. The two principal belligerents were two polities organised around Magadha. On the Nanda side stood the last Nanda ruler, Dhana Nanda, and the Magadha kingdom he headed: its capital was Pataliputra, at the meeting of the Ganges and the Son, its territory ran from the Himalayan foothills and Taxila in the north down to the Ganges delta and the coast of Odisha in the south, and it controlled the most fertile stretch of the South Asian river plain. The Nanda state rested on heavy taxation, a standing army and a very large corps of elephants; the court maintained fiscal officers and a treasurer. Plutarch transmits the saying that the Nanda king's wealth was ten thousand times that left by Darius, while Justin's Epitome records an army of 200,000 infantry, 20,000 cavalry, 2,000 chariots and 2,000 war elephants. These figures are later hearsay and are generally treated as systematically inflated, but they show how enormous the Nandas were imagined to be. The Maurya side was at first not a state at all but an insurgent group built around Chandragupta and planned by Kautilya, its hard core being the troops, horses and elephants of Parvata, king of Matsya, together with archers drawn from the hill and forest tribes and a network of Nanda recruiters who quietly turned to the insurgents. Nor was this a simple collision of two armies: northern states such as Kuru backed the Nandas, and the Maurya coalition's stated aim was to replace the entire fiscal, military and court apparatus of Magadha, so that the goal widened from unseating one dynasty to taking over the machinery of revenue and force that the Nandas had built.
people: 征服難陀帝國的關鍵人物集中在兩頭。難陀一方以末代難陀王達那難陀為核心，他以財富、兵甲與剛愎著稱；宮中的權臣拉克沙那（Rakshasa，即戲劇《指環印》中與新主對峙的那位首相）以及婆藪迦（Vasumitra）一系的將領構成了難陀的軍事高層，婆藪迦在後世的婆羅門系史中被記為在關鍵時刻倒向起兵者，事後仍遭清算。孔雀一方則由旃陀羅笈多（Chandragupta Maurya）與考底利耶（Kautilya，又作錢陀利耶、毗濕努瞿陀）這對搭檔決定全局。考底利耶原是難陀的幕僚，因失寵出走；據《阿濕婆羅衍那家宅儀軌》保存的「難陀化身」故事，他在華氏城的公共遊樂場遇到正在擲骰子博戲的旃陀羅笈多，以棋局比喻國勢，說明難陀國力雖強而其君不仁、其財雖多而其民不給，勸他舉事，事後更授他治國用兵之術；後世把《利論》歸於這位策略家名下，也就由此而來。摩蹉國王帕爾瓦塔是關鍵的第三方：他先在難陀麾下，後倒向旃陀羅笈多並以本部兵馬助戰，成為起兵集團的柱石；按《指環印》與《王河史》系的敘述，他後來因與難陀的姻親故舊之恩反目，被旃陀羅笈多打敗誅除。北方拘羅等邦的君王則是另一邊的重要角色，他們出兵助難陀，兵敗之後又在孔雀的新秩序裡重新安排位置。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities of this war fall into two camps. On the Nanda side the pivot was the last Nanda king, Dhana Nanda, remembered for his wealth, his armaments and his obstinacy; the court heavyweight Rakshasa, the minister who confronts the new ruler in the drama Mudrarakshasa, and the military high command of the Vasumitra family formed the Nanda leadership, and Vasumitra appears in the later Brahmin chronicles as having turned to the insurgents at the crucial moment, only to be purged afterwards. On the Maurya side the outcome was decided by the pair Chandragupta Maurya and Kautilya, also called Canakya or Visnugupta. Kautilya had served the Nanda court and left it out of favour. The Nandaavatara story preserved in the Asvalayana Grhyasutra has him meeting Chandragupta, who was playing a dice game in a public pleasure ground of Pataliputra, and drawing an analogy between the game and the state of the country: the Nanda power was strong but its ruler unkind, its wealth great but its people not provided for. Kautilya pressed him to rise, and afterwards taught him the arts of statecraft and war, which is how the Arthashastra came to be attributed to the same hand. The third key figure was Parvata, king of Matsya, who first served under the Nandas and then came over to Chandragupta with his own troops and horses, becoming the pillar of the insurgent coalition; according to the tradition of Mudrarakshasa and the Rajatarangini he later turned against Chandragupta out of attachment to his Nanda kin and was defeated and killed. The rulers of the northern states such as Kuru played the opposite role: they sent troops to the Nanda side, and after their defeat were reabsorbed into the new order under the Mauryas.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛（Egyptian spear）是青銅時代近東與埃及的標準步兵矛：銅或青銅矛頭以金屬箍固定在木杆上，長度足以在盾牌掩護下刺穿。必須說明的是，這件兵器本身並沒有出現在難陀戰爭的記載裡；它與印度步兵使用的長矛（saṅku）屬於同一時代、同一技術家族的武器，功用完全對應。印度步兵的長矛同樣是銅或青銅矛頭纏縛在木杆上，矛尖寬不過數指，作為弓箭之後的第二武器，供矛兵在近身格鬥時使用；弓始終是主力。難陀與孔雀兩軍實際的裝備組合包括：自製竹木弓（部分以木條或角筋加固弓背）與竹製箭桿、骨、石、銅製箭頭；雙輪戰車由四匹馬牽引，乘員為御者加兩名戰士，一手持弓、一手持矛；最重裝的是象軍，象背設鞍座，上置象夫與弓手，備有象槍與驅象用的象鉤；攻城方面用撞木、雲梯與填壕用的柴草袋，後勤靠牛車運糧、運箭、運柴與載運傷兵。孔雀朝在《利論》裡把這些分門別類：步兵（padati）、騎兵（asvapati）、戰車（rathapati）、象兵（gajapati）與舟師（nauviti），最小作戰單位是四人小組（nada），由 nad 率領；戰車雖在編制之內，實際上已讓位給象兵與密集的步兵矛線。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card is the standard infantry spear of the Bronze Age Near East and Egypt: a copper or bronze head fixed to a wooden shaft with a metal ferrule, long enough to pierce at the shield wall. It must be said plainly that this weapon itself does not appear in any record of the war against the Nandas; it belongs to the same technological family, of the same age, as the spear (saṅku) carried by Indian infantry, and its function corresponds exactly. The Indian spear likewise carried a copper or bronze head bound onto a wooden shaft, the blade only a few fingers wide, and served as the second weapon behind the bow for close combat; the bow remained the primary arm. The actual equipment of the Nanda and Maurya armies included self-made wooden and bamboo bows, some with reinforced backs of wood strips or horn sinew, and bamboo arrow shafts with bone, stone and bronze heads; two-wheeled chariots drawn by four horses, carrying a driver and two fighting men, one with a bow and one with a spear; and above all the elephant corps, with a saddle on the animal's back, an elephant driver and an archer seated above it, a lance and an elephant goad in hand. Siege equipment included rams, ladders and bundles of brush and straw for filling the ditch, and the rear was supplied by ox carts carrying grain, arrows, firewood and the wounded. The Arthashastra of the Maurya court sorts this into classes: infantry (padati), cavalry (asvapati), chariotry (rathapati), elephants (gajapati) and marines (nauviti), the smallest tactical unit being a file of four men (nada) under a nad. The chariot survives in the establishment on paper, but in practice it had already given way to elephants and to dense spear lines of infantry.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術可以分成三段：奇襲、正面攻堅、追擊清剿。奇襲一段的細節來自《阿濕婆羅衍那家宅儀軌》：考底利耶與旃陀羅笈多選定夜裡，同帕爾瓦塔的部隊一起襲擊難陀大軍，難陀王本人在亂軍中退走，軍隊隨即崩解，孔雀聯盟趁勢攻入華氏城。正面攻堅一段是硬碰硬：華氏城依恆河與松河而建，平面近長方形，麥加忒尼記載其木製城牆高聳，上有數百座塔與數百道門，牆外有水溝護衛，攻城方必須先填壕，再以撞木與雲梯在木牆上劈出缺口；木牆易燃，象與火在缺口處的作用被推到最前。追擊清剿一段在廣袤的恆河平原上進行，既要防備潰兵糾合，也要攔截北來援助的邦國軍隊，因此騎兵、象兵與快速分遣的步兵並行，糧秣靠牛車隊與沿途徵集維持。宿營採《利論》所記的營地式樣，先定下營區範圍再挖壕立柵，行軍序列分成前鋒、中軍與後衛三段：前鋒負責接敵，並以佯敗退誘使敵方追擊深入，中軍在後方待命、於關鍵時刻投入，後衛保護糧車與退路。《利論》列出的佯敗、伏擊與斷糧，恰好是這種作戰的標準手法；山林的弓手則多用來襲擾遲滯敵軍的行軍縱隊。
tacticsEn: The tactics of this war can be divided into three phases: the surprise attack, the frontal assault on the walls, and the pursuit and mopping up. The detail of the surprise comes from the Asvalayana Grhyasutra: Kautilya and Chandragupta chose to strike the Nanda army at night together with the troops of Parvata; the Nanda king himself withdrew in the confusion, the army broke up, and the Maurya coalition entered Pataliputra on the momentum of the rout. The assault phase was a hard fight. Pataliputra was built on the Ganges and the Son, roughly rectangular in plan; Megasthenes describes its wooden wall as high, carrying several hundred towers and several hundred gates, with a ditch in front, so the attackers had first to fill the ditch and then breach the wooden curtain with rams and ladders. Because the wall was of timber it burned easily, which put elephants and fire at the forefront of the breach. The pursuit and mopping up took place across the wide Ganges plain, with the need both to prevent broken men from rallying and to intercept relief armies coming down from the north, so cavalry, elephants and rapidly dispatched foot moved in parallel, and the food supply was kept up by ox carts and by requisition along the line of march. Camping followed the pattern recorded in the Arthashastra: the area of the camp was surveyed first, then a ditch and palisade were dug, and the marching order was divided into vanguard, centre and rear. The vanguard made contact and, by a feigned retreat, drew the enemy forward; the centre waited behind and was committed at the decisive moment; the rear guarded the baggage carts and the line of withdrawal. The feigned flight, the ambush and the cutting of supplies listed in the Arthashastra are precisely the standard repertoire of such a campaign, and the archers of the hill and forest zones were used mainly to harass and slow the marching columns of a delayed enemy.
data: 可核的數字不多，但仍有幾組能用。難陀軍的規模在古典文獻中留下的估算最常被引用：查士丁《史記摘要》記難陀的軍隊有步兵二十萬、騎兵二萬、戰車二千、戰象二千；普魯塔克在《亞歷山大傳》中也提到難陀王國擁有的龐大軍隊與財富。這些數字距事件約四百年，來自希臘記者的轉述，學界多認為把兵力系統性放大，只能當作極大的量級概念，不能當作實際點名冊。華氏城的規模有另一組數字：麥加忒尼記載該城為長方形，東西約九又二分之一、南北約六又二分之一個斯塔迪亞（一斯塔迪亞約一百八十五公尺；現代引用常換算為東西約九點五公里、南北約六點五公里），木製城牆上有三百七十五座塔與五百七十道門。孔雀一方的起兵兵數沒有可靠記載，可確定的是班底不大，憑藉內應與盟友的象騎混合部隊取勝；戰後新朝的軍制則留下較清楚的規格：《利論》把步兵細分到四人小組（nada）一級再向上層層統合，並為車、象、騎、步兵各立專門部隊與專門官署。戰爭的起訖年份本身也有兩套說法，一般系於公元前322年至前298年之間，難陀覆亡的年份隨之在公元前322年與前321年之間游移，本卡採用公元前321年。戰役開始的確切月份沒有任何文獻記載，卡面月份欄位填一，僅是體例上的佔位，不代表史實。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are scarce, but a few groups of them survive. The most frequently cited estimate of the Nanda army is that of Justin's Epitome: 200,000 infantry, 20,000 cavalry, 2,000 chariots and 2,000 war elephants; Plutarch's Life of Alexander likewise refers to the vast host and wealth of the Nanda king. These numbers stand roughly four centuries away from the event and reach us through Greek reporting, and are generally held to inflate the forces systematically; they can serve as a measure of magnitude, not as a roll of call. A second group concerns the size of Pataliputra: Megasthenes describes the city as rectangular, about nine and a half stadia by six and a half (one stadium being roughly 185 metres; modern renderings commonly give about 9.5 kilometres by 6.5 kilometres), with a wooden wall carrying 375 towers and 570 gates. The size of the Maurya rising force is not recorded reliably; what can be established is that its core was small and that it won through insiders and a mixed elephant and cavalry force supplied by allies. The military system of the new dynasty after the victory is better specified: the Arthashastra breaks infantry down to files of four men (nada) as the first grade and builds up in successive stages, and it establishes separate corps and separate offices for chariots, elephants, cavalry and infantry. The dating of the war itself carries two versions, the usual range being 322 to 298 BCE, with the fall of the Nandas placed either in 322 or in 321 BCE; this card uses 321 BCE. No source records the month in which the war began, so the month field on the card is filled with 1 purely as a placeholder of house convention and carries no historical claim.
cause: 難陀王朝被推翻，根源不在一次偶然的戰敗，而在它的統治結構。難陀朝在摩揭陀建成了南亞第一個以重稅、常備軍與國家象軍支撐的政體，國庫的積累來自對恆河流域村落的系統性徵收；晚期的難陀君主以奢靡與剛愎聞名，宮廷財富與民間困窮的反差，在佛教與耆那教文獻裡成為難陀暴政的固定形象，《長部》〈燃燈經〉裡那位富甲一方、兵甲齊備卻被勸誡散財的婆羅門，後世解釋多認為影射的就是難陀王朝的現實。這種政體在早期確實有效，它能築起華氏城的木牆，能養出數千頭象，但同時也把數十個小邦推到對立面；摩蹉、拘羅、婆蹉等邦各自有自己的歷史與主權記憶，一旦出現可行的替代者，就會迅速結盟。外部壓力同樣存在：孔雀系所在的山地與邊地社會長期處在難陀的徵召與徵稅之下，考底利耶這類飽學的婆羅門集團在難陀宮廷中屢遭貶抑，乃至被逐被殺；反抗不必由軍閥發起，一場宮廷決裂就足以提供內應。於是公元前321年前後，難陀宮中的裂痕、山地邊區的武裝、山林部落的箭手、摩蹉的馬兵與考底利耶的方案合流，組成那支起義的聯軍。
causeEn: The Nanda dynasty fell not because of one unlucky battle but because of the structure of its rule. The Nandas had built in Magadha the first South Asian polity sustained by heavy taxation, a standing army and a state war-elephant corps, and the accumulation in the royal treasury came from systematic extraction from the villages of the Ganges plain. Late Nanda rulers were noted for extravagance and obstinacy, and the contrast between the wealth of the court and the distress of the countryside became a fixed image of Nanda tyranny in Buddhist and Jain literature; the brahmin in the Digha Nikaya's Fire Sermon, immensely rich and fully armed yet admonished to give his wealth away, has generally been read as a reflection of the Nandas' own situation. The system was genuinely effective in its early phase: it could raise the wooden wall of Pataliputra and maintain thousands of elephants. But it also pushed dozens of smaller states into opposition. Matsya, Kuru, Panchala and others each had their own history and their own memory of sovereignty, and the moment a workable alternative appeared they were quick to ally. External pressure counted too. The mountain and frontier societies from which the Mauryas came had long been subject to Nanda recruitment and Nanda taxation, and learned brahmin groups such as Kautilya's were repeatedly slighted, expelled or killed at the Nanda court. The revolt did not need a general: a breach inside the palace was enough to supply an insider. Around 321 BCE, therefore, the cracks in the Nanda court, the armed men of the marches, the archers of the hills, the horses of Matsya and the plan of Kautilya all came together into the coalition that rose.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是南亞政治版圖的一次重排：難陀王朝百餘年的統治終結，孔雀王朝接管了難陀的疆域、稅制、軍隊與象群，也在華氏城坐穩。比疆域更持久的是制度。難陀朝已經開創的全國性土地清丈、稅基與徵兵制度，被孔雀朝改造並寫進《利論》——四分之一的田賦、荒地招墾的免稅年限、專賣與關稅、官營的軍馬與大象飼養場、連接華氏城與呾叉始羅、烏賈因、托薩利等處的御道與驛站，構成一套後來南亞帝國反覆模仿的模板。考古與銘文所見的孔雀錢幣與銅柱敘銘提到的施政項目，大致沿著這條線展開；麥加忒尼出使孔雀宮廷所記的行政與風俗，則說明這套機器在外部眼中是何等精密。意識形態上，這場勝利又給後世留下一個反面教材：佛典與婆羅門史把難陀王寫成財迷心竅的暴君，難陀一詞從此帶有貶義，與後來南亞政治傳統中對劫掠式集權的反彈一脈相承。往後的王朝更替也常循同一條路：孔雀王朝末年的執政者中就有出自難陀系的將門，難陀作為王朝與軍事貴族的血統記憶，持續存在於孔雀之後的時代。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the war was a rearrangement of the political map of South Asia. A rule of more than a century by the Nandas came to an end, and the Maurya dynasty took over the Nanda territories, tax system, army and herds of elephants, and settled in Pataliputra itself. More durable than the territory was the institutional inheritance: the nationwide land survey, tax base and recruitment system pioneered by the Nandas were reshaped by the Mauryas and written into the Arthashastra, with a quarter of the produce as land tax, tax holidays for settlers brought to waste land, state monopolies and customs duties, state studs for horses and elephants, and a royal road with relay stations running from Pataliputra to Taxila, Ujjain and Tosali. This became a template that later South Asian empires repeatedly copied. The Maurya coinage and the inscriptions on the copper pillars recovered by archaeology, and the administrative details recorded by Megasthenes at the Maurya court, all run along this line, showing how precise the machine looked from outside. Ideologically, the victory also left a reverse example for posterity: Buddhist and Brahmin texts turned the Nanda king into a grasping tyrant, the name Nanda acquired a pejorative sense that runs straight into the South Asian tradition of distrust toward extractive centralisation. Later successions often followed the same pattern. Among the officials of the closing years of the Maurya dynasty were military houses of Nanda descent, and the memory of the Nandas as a dynasty and a military aristocracy persisted into the age after the Mauryas.
result: 結局是難陀王朝的徹底覆亡與孔雀朝的建立。華氏城陷落之後，難陀王本人退走或被擒，末代君主的下落各種記載不一：婆羅門系史與後世傳說多說他被逐，或死於逃亡之地；難陀王室就此退場，其城邑與封地一部份賜給有功將領，一部份歸入孔雀的直轄。北方站在難陀一邊的邦國逐一被平服，孔雀的旗號從恆河平原一路立到印度河上游，取代難陀成為北部印度唯一的強權。聯盟內部的帳也隨即清算：按《指環印》等戲劇與《王河史》系材料的說法，摩蹉國王帕爾瓦塔因與難陀的姻親故舊之恩反目，被旃陀羅笈多打敗誅除；同一批幫助奪位的將領，此後在新朝的軍功序列中一一受封。從此印度進入孔雀的時代：都城仍在華氏城，象軍成為常備主力，財政與軍制脫胎於難陀的框架而更為嚴密，《利論》把這套新秩序的原理寫成文本。隨後兩百多年裡，孔雀王朝是南亞最大的單一政體，也是後來笈多王朝與其他南亞帝國在制度與疆域上反覆比較的基準。
resultEn: The outcome was the total destruction of the Nanda dynasty and the establishment of the Maurya house. After Pataliputra fell, the Nanda king himself withdrew or was taken prisoner, and the later accounts differ about his end: the Brahmin chronicles and later legend commonly say that he was driven out or died in flight. The Nanda house left the stage; some of its towns and appanages were granted to men who had earned them, and the rest passed under direct Maurya administration. The northern states that had stood with the Nandas were subdued in turn, and the Maurya banner was carried from the Ganges plain up to the Indus, replacing the Nandas as the single power in northern India. The coalition's own accounts were then settled: according to the tradition of plays such as Mudrarakshasa and of the Rajatarangini, Parvata of Matsya turned against Chandragupta out of attachment to his Nanda kin and was defeated and killed, while the same men who had helped seize the power were granted fiefs and rank in the new order. India thus entered the Maurya age: the capital remained at Pataliputra, the elephant corps became the standing main arm, the fiscal and military systems were born of the Nanda frame but tightened, and the Arthashastra set down the principles of the new order in writing. For more than two centuries the Maurya dynasty was the largest single polity in South Asia and the standard against which later empires such as the Guptas measured their institutions and their territory.
